get.description:
Issue A reattach protocol (TECH.md 5.1/5.3): if a turn is active, replay every
buffered event from index 0 then keep following live until the terminal event; if
no turn is active, emit a single `idle` event and close. Idempotent — any number of
clients, any number of times, from any tab.

post.description:
Issue C (TECH.md 5.1): retries the failed turn IN PLACE — same assistant row,
same id, reset to streaming — rather than creating a new message row.

get.description:
اصلاحیهٔ ۳ / Issue F (TECH.md 4.5, 8): honest view of the upstream account's own
rate-limit windows — populated only from headers actually seen on the
passthrough path (+ optional probe). No fabricated numbers: if nothing has ever
been captured, `available=false` and only tier/subscription from the
credentials file (if present) are shown.

AdminUserUsageResponse.title: AdminUserUsageResponse
AdminUserUsageResponse.description:
GET /api/admin/users/{id}/usage — same shape as "مصرف من" (MyUsageResponse)
plus admin-only metadata, but reads ONLY usage_ledger/quotas — never
messages/conversations.title/attachments (TECH.md 11.1 privacy rule).

UpstreamLimitsReport.title: UpstreamLimitsReport
UpstreamLimitsReport.description:
اصلاحیهٔ ۳ / Issue F (TECH.md 4.5, 6.1): the litellm handler fire-and-forgets
the raw `anthropic-ratelimit-*` response headers here after every passthrough
call; parsing into window/limit/remaining/reset stays in backend (one place),
not in the handler (which remains a dumb relay).
